# Towers

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_stats.py from config/*.yaml; don't edit by hand. -->

Generated from the game's config by [`scripts/gen_stats.py`](https://github.com/vectorviolet/chokepoint/blob/main/scripts/gen_stats.py); don't edit it by hand. [Back to the index](README.md).

Per level. **Cost** is what reaching that level costs (the buy price at level 1, the upgrade price after); **Total spent** adds up every step; **Sell refund** is 70% of the total. **Range** and **Blind spot** are radii in px: a tower can target an enemy when blind spot < distance <= range. **Reload** is the time between shots; **DPS** is damage per second against one target (damage / reload). The game checks reloads once per tick (1/165 s), so a real reload can run up to one tick longer. **DPS per $** is DPS divided by the total spent. **HP** is how much tank fire the tower takes before it is destroyed.

## 1. Rapid gun

Cheap and fires fast. Short range, low damage, no upgrades.

## 4. Plane

Splash bombs along its flight; tanks can't hit it. Flies once to the map's right edge, then it's gone.

A plane flies once to the map's right edge, dropping a bomb every 500 ms; each bomb deals its damage to every enemy inside its splash radius where it lands. Planes have no HP, can't be sold and aren't upgraded one by one: the one-time **UPG PLANES** upgrade ($5,000) makes every plane level 2, including the ones already flying. A plane always costs its level-1 price.
